text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

The game is over. The town wins. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the killer, Gemma the officer, Sol the doctor, Luna the citizen, Terra the citizen.

Haiku was voted out on Day 1 after a messy pile-on that started with Terra and quickly turned into accusations of dodging. On Night 2 Luna was lost, and on Day 2 Gemma claimed to be the officer and said she had checked Sonnet and found a killer. Sonnet made the big mistake by arguing against Gemma's claim instead of letting it sit, which drew the town's votes and sealed the game. The town won when Sonnet was voted out, with Haiku and Sonnet revealed as the two killers, and Gemma, Sol, Luna and Terra as the innocent players.
